# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Independent Linux UAPI capget/procfs/prctl observations.
# https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man2/capget.2.html
# https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man7/capabilities.7.html
import ctypes, json, os, pathlib, platform, sys
assert platform.machine() == 'x86_64'
lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
class Header(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('version', ctypes.c_uint32), ('pid', ctypes.c_int)]
class Word(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('effective', ctypes.c_uint32), ('permitted', ctypes.c_uint32), ('inheritable', ctypes.c_uint32)]
names = ('CHOWN DAC_OVERRIDE DAC_READ_SEARCH FOWNER FSETID KILL SETGID SETUID SETPCAP '
         'LINUX_IMMUTABLE NET_BIND_SERVICE NET_BROADCAST NET_ADMIN NET_RAW IPC_LOCK '
         'IPC_OWNER SYS_MODULE SYS_RAWIO SYS_CHROOT SYS_PTRACE SYS_PACCT SYS_ADMIN '
         'SYS_BOOT SYS_NICE SYS_RESOURCE SYS_TIME SYS_TTY_CONFIG MKNOD LEASE AUDIT_WRITE '
         'AUDIT_CONTROL SETFCAP MAC_OVERRIDE MAC_ADMIN SYSLOG WAKE_ALARM BLOCK_SUSPEND '
         'AUDIT_READ PERFMON BPF CHECKPOINT_RESTORE').split()
keys = ['permitted', 'effective', 'inheritable', 'ambient', 'bounding']
selected = (1 << 13) | (1 << 39) | (1 << 40)
full = (1 << 41) - 1
def read(pid):
    header = Header(0x20080522, pid)
    words = (Word * 2)()
    assert lib.syscall(125, ctypes.byref(header), ctypes.byref(words)) == 0, ctypes.get_errno()
    masks = {key: getattr(words[0], key) | (getattr(words[1], key) << 32) for key in keys[:3]}
    proc = dict(line.split(':', 1) for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/%d/status' % pid).read_text().splitlines() if ':' in line)
    for key, label in zip(keys, ['CapPrm', 'CapEff', 'CapInh', 'CapAmb', 'CapBnd']):
        value = int(proc[label], 16)
        if key in masks:
            assert masks[key] == value, (key, masks[key], value)
        else:
            masks[key] = value
    return masks
def own_prctl(masks):
    for index in range(41):
        assert lib.prctl(23, index, 0, 0, 0) == ((masks['bounding'] >> index) & 1)
        assert lib.prctl(47, 1, index, 0, 0) == ((masks['ambient'] >> index) & 1)
def check_state(pid, mode):
    assert int(pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/kernel/cap_last_cap').read_text()) == 40
    masks = read(pid)
    if mode == 'empty':
        assert os.geteuid() == 2000
        assert all(masks[key] == 0 for key in keys[:4]), masks
    else:
        assert os.geteuid() == 0
        assert masks == dict(permitted=full, effective=full, inheritable=selected, ambient=selected, bounding=full), masks
    own_prctl(masks)
    return masks
def render(mask):
    return ','.join('CAP_' + name for i, name in enumerate(names) if mask & (1 << i))
def main():
    operation, pid, mode = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
    masks = check_state(pid, mode)
    if operation == 'control':
        return
    if operation == 'probe':
        assert sys.argv[4:] == ['0', '0'], sys.argv[4:]
        expected = ''.join(key + ': ' + render(masks[key]) + '\n' for key in keys)
        assert pathlib.Path('probe.out').read_text() == expected
        assert pathlib.Path('values.out').read_text() == expected
        assert all(pathlib.Path(name).read_bytes() == b'' for name in ['probe.err', 'bind.out', 'bind.err'])
    elif operation == 'has':
        spellings = [('CAP_NET_RAW', 13), ('cap_net_raw', 13), ('NET_RAW', 13), ('Net_Raw', 13), ('CAP_BPF', 39), ('bpf', 39), ('CaP_Checkpoint_Restore', 40)]
        expected = ''.join(name + ':' + str(0 if masks['effective'] & (1 << bit) else 1) + '\n' for name, bit in spellings)
        assert pathlib.Path('statuses.out').read_text() == expected
        assert pathlib.Path('has.out').read_bytes() == b'' and pathlib.Path('has.err').read_bytes() == b''
    else:
        raise AssertionError(operation)
    pathlib.Path('kernel-masks.json').write_text(json.dumps(masks, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    print('capability ' + operation + ' verified')
if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import ctypes, os, sys
import oracle
assert os.geteuid() == 0
current = oracle.read(os.getpid())
assert current['permitted'] == current['effective'] == current['bounding'] == oracle.full
header = oracle.Header(0x20080522, 0)

for i in range(2):
    words[i].effective = (oracle.full >> (32 * i)) & 0xffffffff
    words[i].permitted = words[i].effective
    words[i].inheritable = (oracle.selected >> (32 * i)) & 0xffffffff
assert oracle.lib.syscall(126, ctypes.byref(header), ctypes.byref(words)) == 0, ctypes.get_errno()

    assert oracle.lib.prctl(47, 2, bit, 0, 0) == 0, ctypes.get_errno()
oracle.check_state(os.getpid(), 'populated')
if len(sys.argv) > 1:
    os.execv(sys.argv[1], [sys.argv[1], '--noprofile', '--norc', 'case.sh'])

cases.purpose: Unknown capability lookup rejects before capget
cases.oracle: Documented unknown-name status and a positively controlled seccomp kill filter on capget.
cases.setup_script: if /usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-seccomp.py --kill capget -- /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import ctypes;ctypes.CDLL(None).syscall(125,0,0)' >control.out 2>control.err; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi; [[ $rc == 159 ]] || exit 90; rm -f control.out control.err
cases.script: /usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-seccomp.py --kill capget -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'caps has NOT_A_CAPABILITY >out 2>err; rc=$?; text=$(<err); [[ ! -s out && $text == *"unknown capability"* ]] || exit 90; printf "status=%s stdout=empty diagnostic=unknown\n" "$rc"'
